EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

IN the exercise of the powers vested in me by Section 7 (1) of the Presidential Elections Act, No. 15 of 1981, I, MahindaDeshapriya, Commissioner of Elections do hereby appoint the Returning Officers mentioned by designation in Column II ofthe Schedule for each Electoral District in the corresponding entry in Column I of that Schedule.
